chars.TWINS: two identical Moroccan twin brothers in their early twenties, same face, short black curly hair, light stubble, both wearing identical red football jerseys with a white number 7 and black shorts
chars.ACCUSER: a skinny Moroccan young man with a buzz cut and thin moustache, wearing a lime green football training bib over a grey t-shirt and black track pants

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Neighbourhood dirt football pitch in Casablanca at sunset. Seen from the side of the pitch, head-to-waist: the ACCUSER shouts angrily and points his finger at the TWINS standing right in front of him, his face twisted with mocking anger; the twins are frozen, shocked. Apartment buildings softly in the background.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot on the same dirt football pitch at sunset: the ACCUSER smirks, rubbing his thumb and fingers together in a money gesture, leaning forward provocatively, other players blurred far behind.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Medium shot of the TWINS on the dirt football pitch at sunset, looking at each other confused and suspicious, one frowning with raised hands as if asking what he means, sweat on their faces.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Chaotic scuffle on the dirt football pitch at dusk: other young players in plain white t-shirts hold back the angry TWINS by the arms as they lunge toward the ACCUSER, who steps back with a nervous face. Dust in the air. No blood.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Against the concrete wall at the edge of the football pitch at dusk: the TWINS stand close on both sides of the ACCUSER, cornering him, one twin pressing a hand on the wall next to his head, staring him down; the accuser looks scared and avoids their eyes. A small crowd of young men watches from behind.
